svg.title: Per-user VS Code on AWS Lambda MicroVMs: architecture
svg.desc: Users sign in with Amazon Cognito. The site CloudFront distribution serves the start page from Amazon S3 and routes /api/* to an HTTP API with a Cognito JWT authorizer. The session Lambda function, which stores state in DynamoDB, finds or launches the user's Lambda MicroVM and returns a one-time ticket. The browser redeems the ticket on the separate IDE CloudFront distribution, whose CloudFront Function routes /ide/* to that user's own MicroVM running openvscode-server and adds the MicroVM auth header. Each user has an isolated MicroVM.
svg.text: Sign in: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE
Sign in with Amazon Cognito (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE)
POST /api/session: find or launch the user's MicroVM, get a one-time ticket
GET /launch?t=ticket on the IDE host: MicroVM token set as HttpOnly cookies
/ide/*: the CloudFront Function routes to the user's MicroVM with the auth header
Per-user VS Code on AWS Lambda MicroVMs
